title: Local TV ad cost: broadcast, cable and streaming

facts.fact: Local TV ad cost usually runs from a few hundred dollars to several thousand per airing, with market size and daypart setting most of the range, according to 2026 guidance the page attributes to Comcast Advertising and National Media Spots.
facts.value: a few hundred to several thousand dollars
facts.quote: A local TV ad cost usually runs from a few hundred dollars to several thousand per airing.

facts.fact: National Media Spots lists local broadcast TV at $500 to $10,000 per month.
facts.quote: | Local broadcast TV | $500 to $10,000 | Per month | National Media Spots | June 13, 2026 |

facts.fact: National Media Spots lists regional cable TV at $1,000 to $20,000 per month.
facts.quote: | Regional cable TV | $1,000 to $20,000 | Per month | National Media Spots | June 13, 2026 |

facts.fact: National Media Spots lists streaming/CTV at $500 to $50,000+ per month.
facts.quote: | Streaming/CTV | $500 to $50,000+ | Per month | National Media Spots | June 13, 2026 |

facts.fact: National Media Spots lists streaming/CTV at $15 to $40+ CPM.
facts.quote: | Streaming/CTV | $15 to $40+ | CPM | National Media Spots | June 13, 2026 |

facts.fact: Amazon Ads lists TV 30-second spot pricing at $5 to $30 CPM, with no publication date stated.
facts.quote: | TV, 30-second spot | $5 to $30 | CPM | Amazon Ads | Date not stated |

facts.fact: National Media Spots states that CTV campaigns can launch on $500 to $1,000 a month.
facts.quote: National Media Spots notes that CTV campaigns can launch on $500 to $1,000 a month.

facts.fact: Per Moonb's 2026 guide as reported on the page, a Super Bowl 30-second spot averaged about $8 million in airtime, with some above $10 million, citing NBC via Bloomberg.
facts.value: about $8 million average; some above $10 million
facts.quote: About $8 million average, some above $10 million

facts.fact: Moonb's 2026 guide puts a simple local TV spot production at $1,500 to $10,000.
facts.quote: Moonb’s 2026 guide puts a simple local spot at $1,500 to $10,000 for production.

facts.fact: Per Moonb's 2026 guide as reported on the page, professional mid-range TV commercial production runs $10,000 to $50,000.
The page describes the SQAD cost-per-point method: the market's SQAD cost per point multiplied by the Nielsen rating of the program airing then approximates the spot price.
facts.quote: take the SQAD cost per point for the market and multiply it by the Nielsen rating of the program airing at that time.

facts.fact: National Media Spots describes prime time as typically 8 to 11 PM, the daypart with the highest rates.
facts.quote: Prime time (typically 8 to 11 PM) carries the highest rates because viewing peaks then.

facts.fact: BIA's September 2026 update puts 2026 local political spending at $9.7 billion, up from $8.4 billion in April.
facts.quote: The September update puts local political spending at $9.7 billion for 2026, up from $8.4 billion in April.

facts.fact: BIA says $1.2 billion of the $1.3 billion increase in 2026 local political spending went to TV OTA (broadcast) and TV OTT (streaming).
facts.quote: Of that $1.3 billion increase, BIA says $1.2 billion went to TV OTA (broadcast) and TV OTT (streaming).

facts.fact: BIA's first look at 2027 has local political spending falling to about $1.1 billion, with total local revenue roughly flat at $186.5 billion.
facts.quote: Its first look at 2027 has political spending falling to about $1.1 billion in the off-cycle year, with total local revenue roughly flat at $186.5 billion.
